title: A Treatise on Qi-Tempered Aim
summary: Teaches the rifleman to temper breath, pulse and qi into one aim that can find the seam in an armoured foe.

title: Canon of the Held Position
summary: Sets out how a rifleman holds a post against a determined push, from the parapet to the last-charge counterstroke.

title: Treatise on Rifle Fire Through the Qi Field
summary: Shows a qi-field cultivator how to extend the field along the barrel so shot, sense and step work as one.

title: The Far-Reaching Marksman: An Advanced Course
summary: Carries the qi-field marksman to the extreme end of the rifle's reach, with sense, concealment and piercing shot.

title: Treatise of the Twin Rest and Hawk Eye
summary: Teaches the Azure Sky pairing of two rests and a hawk's fixed gaze, leading to the dual-track piercing shot.

title: Handbook of the Basin Crossfire
summary: Trains paired riflemen to cross their lines of fire across a basin and to keep that fire unbroken.

title: Canon of the Dual-Track Long Rifle
summary: Sets out the two-track discipline of the Azure Sky long rifle, one track for the field and one for the barrel.

title: River-Line Marksman's Treatise
summary: Teaches the long-bank shooter's craft of reading river, haze and drift and sending one piercing shot along the water.
